decisions.reason: The Definition explicitly restricts its domain to even-order integral matrices; it does not assert that all link Seifert matrices have even order. Congruences and the two rank-two enlargements preserve that domain, and finite reversible moves define an equivalence relation, including the empty matrix. The knot-focused home page and manifest promise this same restricted definition. Odd-order link matrices lie outside its expressly stated domain, so their existence contradicts no clause.

F7 attributes diagram existence without qualification to a supplier whose Statement requires a link contained in R3. Repaired F7 and step 1.1: rotate a point outside c∪d to infinity, check the induced complement homology isomorphisms preserve positive meridians and hence both linking coefficients, and apply projection only to the rotated R3 link.
